study type: cross sectional, retrospective and observational study
cohort: 92 pregnant women between 20 and 46 years of age who were diagnosed with gestational diabetes after the 24th week of pregnancy and who were treated at the Department of Pathology of Pregnancy, Clinical Centre Kragujevac.
finding: The average body weight of newborns from pregnancies complicated by gestational diabetes was 3587.07 grams, which is very close to the macrosomia limit of 4000 grams.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was dominant, with episiotomy in almost half the cases.
